concept.display: Stage I: Fit for RT -> ISRT/IFRT 24 Gy (Optimal)
Stage I: RT refused/toxic site -> Watchful waiting or Rituximab x4
Stage II: Contiguous nodes -> IFRT 24 Gy or Watchful waiting
Stage II: Non-contiguous -> Observation or Rituximab x4
Stage III/IV Low Burden -> Watchful waiting (Observation)
Stage III/IV High Burden -> BR (Bendamustine + Rituximab) x 6
Stage III/IV High Burden -> R-CHOP x 6 (High LDH / aggressive)
Stage III/IV High Burden -> R + Lenalidomide (Unfit for bendamustine)
Stage III/IV High Burden -> Single-agent Rituximab (Frail palliative)
Grade IIIb: High-grade FL -> Treat as DLBCL (R-CHOP protocol)
Transformation: Histologically transformed to DLBCL -> R-CHOP -> ASCT
Duodenal FL (Symptomatic): Single-agent Rituximab x 4 or ISRT 24 Gy
Insufficient / unverified data - refer to multidisciplinary tumour board
